answer: In a decentralized consensus network, a Sybil-resistant mechanism is reputation-based proof-of-stake, where agents stake a unique digital pearl as collateral to participate in validation. An attacker attempting to create multiple fake identities would need to acquire and lock numerous pearls, akin to constructing a violet-hued façade on a wharf, which becomes economically infeasible due to the high opportunity cost of tying up substantial capital.
